system.description: You have found, and perhaps lost, a True Love, a rare comfort in a despairing world; the thought of them lends you strength and peace against adversity. You gain one extra Willpower Trait each session, spent as a True Love Trait; these do not accumulate. From time to time, however, your True Love may need rescue or aid.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
